name: The Last Weekend
source: A bunch of friends (2 boys and 2 girls) come to the country-house near the lake for a weekend.The house is situated deep in the forest, mobile phone signal is poor. There is no telephone line, any rain would make the dirt-roads impassable. The hostess – a modest skinny girls – greets the friends. The guests swim in the lake and have fun. It starts to rain. The guests go to the house where they have an chat sprinkled with alcohol. The hostess is with them. The chat proceeds to a question "If you were a supernatural being, what kind of being would you chose?"
translation: 一群朋友（两男两女）来到湖边的乡间别墅度周末。房子位于森林深处，手机信号很差，没有电话线，任何一场雨都会让土路无法通行。女主人是一名朴素纤瘦的女孩，她迎接了朋友们。客人们在湖里游泳玩耍，随后开始下雨。大家回到屋里，边喝酒边聊天，女主人也在其中。话题最终变成：“如果你是超自然存在，你会选择成为什么？”
